title: Among cards that are either restricted or banned in any competitive format
question: Among cards that are either restricted or banned in any competitive format and have a text box, find the most common visual frame effect for non-powerful foil cards (where at least one of cardKingdomId or cardKingdomFoilId is missing) that are not multi-faced and belong to sets released after 2010.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_018"
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE c."XCL_072" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_086" 
    FROM legalities AS l 
    WHERE l."XCL_085" IN ('Restricted', 'Banned')
)
  AND c."XCL_022" = 0
  AND (c."XCL_006" IS NULL OR c."XCL_007" IS NULL)
  AND c."XCL_037" = 'normal'
  AND s."XCL_112" > '2010-12-31'
GROUP BY c."XCL_018"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
WHERE c."XCL_072" IN (

    FROM legalities AS l 
    WHERE l."XCL_085" IN ('Restricted', 'Banned')

  AND c."XCL_022" = 0

  AND c."XCL_037" = 'normal'
  AND s."XCL_112" > '2010-12-31'
GROUP BY c."XCL_018"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
